A [[Gender|male]] '''Quarren boatman''' offered to take [[Din Djarin]] and [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] to meet more Mandalorians on his [[Boat|trawler]]. However, he betrayed them en-route by throwing the Child into the maw of a hungry [[mamacore]] and attempting to drown Din so he could scavenge his [[beskar]] armor. Before they could do so, however, he and his entire crew were [[Death|killed]] by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and her [[Mandalorian resistance|Mandalorians]], who proceeded to rescue Din and the Child before blowing up the trawler. The Quarren's [[Unidentified Quarren boatman's brother|brother]] later ambushed Din and tried to kill him and the Child in revenge, only for him and his associates to be summarily killed as well by Kryze and her [[Nite Owls|Nite Owl]] companions.<ref name="Chapter 11" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The boatman appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]," the eleventh episode of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]]<ref name="Chapter 11" /> and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref>
